subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Air
overview: Seven days linking sunny Xiamen with the north-east’s winter sights: Harbin Ice-Snow World, the Russian-style Chateau Volga, the Siberian Tiger Park and Changchun. Hotels are 4-star in Xiamen and 5-star in the north. Flights are with Xiamen Air, with one meal upgraded to Ice Palace hotpot and one to BBQ.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 28–Jan 3 2026 to Dec 28–Jan 3 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Xiamen
items: Fly Manila to Xiamen (MF820 21:20/23:35); meet the guide.
Transfer to hotel. Meals: X/X/X.

itinerary.title: Xiamen – Jilin
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Free and easy until transfer to the airport; fly Xiamen to Changchun (MF8047 14:05/17:45); meet the Harbin guide.
Visit a cotton-padded jacket shop.
Transfer to hotel in Jilin. Meals: B/X/D.

itinerary.title: Jilin – Harbin
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Drive to Harbin.
Visit the Songhua River, Stalin Park, Central Street, Flood Control Monument and Sophia Church Square.
Visit Harbin Ice-Snow World.
Transfer to hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Harbin
items: Hotel breakfast.
Visit the Russian handicrafts mall and Chocolate Workshop.
Visit Chateau Volga, St. Nicholas Church, the snow circle, Vodka Fort (small vodka and snack) and the Pushkin Exhibition Hall.
Optional tour: Russian dance and song performance + horse-drawn sleigh ride. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Harbin – Changchun
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit the Siberian Tiger Park and the Middle East Railway Bridge.
Harbin Grand Theater (outside view) and the giant snowman sculpture.
Transfer to hotel in Changchun.
Optional tour: Songhua River cable car + afternoon tea at Shangri-La Hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Changchun – Xiamen
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Nanhu Park and Cultural Square; photo stop at Geological Palace.
Free shopping at The Hill business area.
Fly Changchun to Xiamen (MF8048 18:50/22:55). Meals: B/X/X.

itinerary.title: Xiamen – Manila
items: Hotel breakfast and check out.
Visit Huwei Mountain on the Xiamen Mountains-to-Sea Trail and Shapowei Business Area.
Free shopping at Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street; lunch at your own expense.
Transfer to the airport; fly Xiamen to Manila (MF819 17:35/20:20). Meals: B/X/X.

placeDesc.Songhua River: The river running through Harbin, with riverside promenades and parks.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park in Harbin along the Songhua River.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's historic pedestrian street lined with European-style buildings.
placeDesc.Sophia Church Square: The square around Harbin's well-known Byzantine-style Saint Sophia Cathedral.
placeDesc.Harbin Ice-Snow World: A large winter theme park in Harbin with giant ice and snow sculptures.
placeDesc.Chateau Volga: A Russian-style themed estate in Harbin with replica buildings and gardens.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian-style church replica at Chateau Volga, visited on the tour.
placeDesc.Vodka Fort: A themed vodka fort at Chateau Volga where the tour includes a small vodka and snack.
placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A park near Harbin that breeds Siberian tigers, visited with a safari-style viewing experience.
placeDesc.Middle East Railway Bridge: A historic railway bridge over the Songhua River near Harbin.
placeDesc.Harbin Grand Theater: A modern landmark theatre in Harbin, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Nanhu Park: A lakeside city park in Changchun, visited along with the Cultural Square.
placeDesc.Huwei Mountain: A hill in Xiamen on the Mountains-to-Sea Trail, visited for views over the coast.
placeDesc.Shapowei Business Area: A harbour-side district in Xiamen with cafes, art spaces and shops.
placeDesc.Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street: Xiamen's old-style pedestrian shopping street, given as free time with lunch on your own.
